The main takeaway from our work is that

the dispersion equation and eigenmodes of a longitudinally magnetised gyroelectromagnetic waveguide filled with alternating ferrite and semiconducting layers are derived and the hybrid modes are investigated in details.

the dispersion equation for the waveguide system under study is a transcendental equation, which can be solved only numerically, and the number of the supported modes is not fixed and depends on the waveguide dimensions and on the parameters of the waveguide system.

the dispersion characteristics of the system can be controlled by the static magnetic field, the thickness of the layers, and the relative dielectric permittivity and magnetic permeability of the materials.
